_schema: qec_twin.code_status.v1 — hand-maintained status overlay for tools/gen_code_map.py. Keys = package paths relative to src/ (fully-qualified, e.g. 'qec_twin/forward', 'error_coupling_simulator/source'), OR dev-tooling package keys (prefixed by their repo-relative root, e.g. 'tools', 'tests/harness'), or a module path for a per-module override. status in {ACTIVE, PLACEHOLDER, ARCHIVED, TOOLING}. gen_code_map.py DRIFT-CHECKS this against the code: add an entry when a new package appears, remove one when a package is deleted (both are flagged in CODE_MAP.md's DRIFT CHECK). '_'-prefixed keys are config, not packages.

_local_index._note: Curated CLUSTERS of load-bearing LOCAL-ONLY working code under gitignored outputs/ (NOT committed; present on the build workstation). Maintain the GLOBS (stable); gen_code_map auto-discovers the FILES matching them, so new nm_*/cert_*/quantum_bath_* appear without editing this. Globs are relative to the repo root. NOTE: source/ + oracles/ have been re-homed into src/error_coupling_simulator/ (MIGRATION P1); the outputs/teacher_prereg/ copies below are FROZEN LEGACY — the package is canonical.

tools.note: dev tooling (NOT shipped): gen_code_map (this map generator, AST-only), sync_obsidian

tests/harness.note: Python test/coverage HARNESS (lives WITH the tests; replaces the .sh runners): proc (process-group launcher — no orphaned workers), gpu_pool (multi-GPU semaphore, ECS_GPUS), gate + mutation registry-driven runners, coverage_audit (AST-derived per-unit coverage audit)

error_coupling_simulator.note: NEW standalone releasable package (MIGRATION in progress, docs/error_coupling_simulator_MIGRATION.md). Consolidates the coupling-error simulator from qec_twin + gitignored outputs/. No physical ground truth — teachers = specified noise models, oracles = FORMAL bug-catchers.

The lower-level wedge machinery (nm_*) + the qutip oracles were REMOVED in the 2026-07-03 SCREENING (nothing wires them yet); they re-home at P6 (quantum-bath teacher). Keep the package lean.

error_coupling_simulator/quantum_bath.note: P6-landed (2026-07-05): the pseudomode-enlarged shared-bath GKSL carrier, extracted from the notion-3 relaxation x dual-axis study (outputs/twin_validation/notion3_relaxation_dualaxis_run.py). 2 data + 2 ancilla + ONE shared mode; sigma_z dephasing + sigma_minus EMISSION into the same mode; exact-DM CPU (16*nmax, feasibility-only); dual-axis (X+Z) syndrome record. LESSON: K/K_X/K_Z are all forgeable by an incoherent AD (basis-symmetric) => the honest discriminator is the model-free record-distance.
